content: Ken ọmaana Ebẹl
Iwa Adam oyima kwanọng kwẹ Iv abẹ, Iv otzima ibhọr ọmaan Ken. Iv oben bi, “K'ẹkkaana ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọnang-m, kaam nkk'nnwa kw'ijinọng mmaana.”
Wa Iv obiro otzima ibhọr ọmaan ọgbaanọkka kwa Ken, kw'ode Ebẹl. Iwa Ebẹl ode okkeri arukhimaan. Ken ode ọnọng kw'ọyaabh owoni.
Okwu otzuma k'ogbe mẹ, Ken otzima achiduk p'owoni kwẹ, osi ẹnanga ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
Ebẹl ọtzọkha acheden-va p'arukhimaan pẹ p'ajibhi for, otzima osi ẹnanga. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọdaam ettem ttara Ebẹl ọmaana ẹnanga chẹ.
Onode Ken ọmaana ẹnanga chẹ, Ibinọkpaabyi ettem kẹ kẹdaami. Mẹ wọ osi, Ken ettem epyibh-ẹ, on-obhor itzitzikha.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbọbh Ken bi, “Ode yan kw'ettem epyibh-ọ? Osi yan kw'abhori itzitzikha?
Idikha ira kọ akk'ejibha asa, ira kaam ettem kindaam ttar-ọ o? Yina, da ani ejibha asi, epyibha ẹm-ẹbaami bi, ẹbọkh-ọ. Kọ akhaambi, akhema chẹ.”
Wa Ken okwu ọkhaama nttọhna ttara ọgbaanọkka Ebẹl, oben-ẹ bi, “Tte moyin k'ẹtzam.” Mada abẹ awobh k'ẹtzam, Ken ottum ọgbaanọkka Ebẹl ofhu.
Mẹ wọ osi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbọbh Ken bi, “Agbaanakka Ebẹl ko o?” Ken obhina bi, “Kaam kinnong, kaam wọ mminkkeri ọgbaanọkka kwaam o?”
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Bọng odik kw'asi ma? Izi s'agbaanakka im-ibhomi iyer-m k'irek, mach'ẹmọng ch'ebhomi eror ẹkkaana.
Mẹ wọ osi, nnang-ọ ẹmma, mbiri ngwubh-ọ k'irerek s'igwong ẹmma igwo izi s'agbaanakka kw'afhu.
Kọ ayaabh irerek, ekpo dọk kéjibh ẹnang-ọ. Kọ ẹwọr k'ibe rani kábọkha, án-ade ottettena-nọng m'ọyagbin.”
Ken oben Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi bi, “Ihem saam ibari iyọhng-m bi ndọhkha.
Mayina akk'aam akhubha m'irerek nna, ọmaana k'itzitzikha sọ, kaam nna nnọbh ebhon, mbiri nde ottettena-nọng m'ọyagbin, ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'óre-m ófhu-m ofhu.”

Yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi on-oben Ken bi, “Ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọfhọ-ọ, ọ́tzọkha ọmmamma kw'ọ́yọhnga kwọ, igbe izenamfa.” Mẹ wọ osi, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okhe Ken ebhora ka for, ifha ọnọng kpenamkpen kw'ọ́rẹ-ẹ oning-ẹ ófhu.
Ken obina k'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ottena, otza oruk k'irek sa Nọd, k'okhubha kw'ewuchen em-eyin k'Iden.
Efonamma cha Ken
Wa Ken oyima kwanọng kwẹ abẹ, kwanọng otzima ibhọr ọmaan Ẹnọk. M'ogbe nwa, wa Ken om-osi obhon. Che cha nnwa kwẹ Ẹnọk, ch'ọtzọk okpe obhon nwa.
Wa Lamẹk ọtzọk panọng afa; wani okpen Ada, nwonggo okpena Zila.
Wa Ada ọmaan Jabal, kẹ wọ iwa ode otte kw'anọng p'iwa am-aruk k'okhira, abira atzir nden.
Ọgbaanọkka kwẹ okpena Jubal, kẹ wọ ode otte kw'anọng p'abhaa ogim-ogim okhikhir, am-abira agyi ophoropho.
Zila, obiro ọmaan Tubal-Ken, kw'om-oduk brons ọmaana akkonga otzima osi ekpo k'adem-k'adem. Ọgbaanọkka kwa Tubal-Ken kw'ikwanọng ode Naama.
Wa Lamẹk on-oben panọng pẹ bi,

content.text: Idikha ọnọng manda wani ofhu Ken,
kẹ óre ihem s'iyọhnga sa Ken igbe izenamfa,
Yina, idikha ọnọng ofhu kaam Lamẹk, okhuri odikkobh kw'akaam mfhu,
kẹ óre ihem s'iyọhnga s'ọnọng kw'ofhu Ken, igbe arọbh attaan obhiri chi obhiri afa.”

content: Ẹmmaana cha Sẹt ọmaana Ẹnọs
Wa Adam obiro oyima kwanọng kwẹ abẹ, kwanọng otzima ibhọr ọmaan nnwa kw'ijinọng, ọkpẹ-ẹ Sẹt, oben bi, “Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam nnwa ọdọdọk ọnanga kw'otzer eho ch'Ebẹl, kwa Ken ofhu.”
Sẹt obiro obhon nnwa kw'ijinọng, ọkpẹ-ẹ Ẹnọs. Wa k'ogbe kw'Ẹnọs wọ kw'anọng attẹwọr akpobha che ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.
